name: Example: Applying De Moivre's Theorem
worked_solution:
De Moivre's Theorem states that

$$
\left[ \cos(\varphi) + \textrm{i}\sin(\varphi) \right]^n = \cos(n\varphi) + \textrm{i}\sin{(n\varphi)}.
$$

In our expression, we have $n=4$ and $\varphi=\dfrac{\theta}{10}.$ Substituting in these values, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{[\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\theta }{10})+\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\theta }{10})]}^{4} & =\operatorname{cos}⁡(4\cdot \frac{\theta }{10})+\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(4\cdot \frac{\theta }{10}) \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{2\theta }{5})+\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{2\theta }{5}).\end{aligned}
$$
